A_EXTERNAL_FIELD.disposition: Control is used inside selected C, not separate SCF campaign

B_ELECTRONIC_EXCITATION.cost: Small response problem after bounded RHF
B_ELECTRONIC_EXCITATION.disposition: Parameter source for selected C; never label frequency-domain calculation as real-time TDDFT

C_QUANTUM_TIME_STATE.new_space: Complex amplitudes, phase/coherence, population and real physical control time
C_QUANTUM_TIME_STATE.maturity: QuTiP5.2.1 Qobj/QobjEvo/sesolve; Octopus is a fuller real-space alternative
C_QUANTUM_TIME_STATE.value: Allows prepare/control/propagate/measure beyond structure snapshots across multiple future tasks

C_QUANTUM_TIME_STATE.disposition: SELECTED if computed excitation bridge passes its frozen domain checks

route: Existing WorldSpec and immutable structural state -> bounded PySCF RHF/TDA singlet data -> explicitly truncated dipole-coupled effective basis -> QuTiP sesolve with time-dependent electric field -> immutable effective quantum states and observations
first_object: Fixed-nuclei neutral H2 at0.74Angstrom, centered inversion-symmetric geometry, RHF/cc-pVDZ, up to6 TDA singlet roots; not a repeat of static H2 validation
why_object: Inversion symmetry permits zero diagonal dipoles for nondegenerate parity states, avoiding invented excited-state permanent dipoles. Low-cost electronic excitation/field-control domain, not a new-material claim.
bridge: Lowest isolated longitudinal dipole-bright positive converged TDA root plus reference. Root choice is a frozen physical model projection, not AI feedback. Numerical energies/moments must be computed, never prefilled. Two basis labels represent response-derived effective states, not exact many-electron eigenfunctions or KS orbitals.
why_not_octopus_now: Real-space real-time TDDFT has broader microscopic fidelity but new binary/build, pseudopotential/mesh/box/propagator admission is not yet established within1GiB/15min. Not installed or benchmarked; not declared impossible.
first_question: Does a weak resonant longitudinal pulse in the computed two-state effective model produce excited population and coherence while preserving norm, and is the result stable under a single predeclared tighter ODE tolerance check?
first_prediction: Conditional on a converged isolated bright root and weak coupling screen: nonzero excited population above1e-6 during a400atomic-time-unit pulse; norm error below1e-7, coarse/tight population difference below1e-6. No exact population, material excitation accuracy or full-electron real-time claim.

control.carrier: Computed selected positive excitation gap divided by hbar, phase0; hbar=1 in atomic units

failure: No converged positive isolated longitudinal bright root among frozen roots
Dipole bridge or inversion/nondegenerate assumptions unsupported
Coupling not weak relative to gap or computed omitted-root separations
claim_ceiling: Response-derived two-state closed effective model driven by an explicitly supplied classical field; not real-time TDHF/TDDFT, exact molecular dynamics, full material response, W2 or original discovery
